The color of an eggplant is purple.

**Beginning:** Ben, living in isolation on a remote farm, unexpectedly discovers he possesses the unique ability to communicate with the local animal inhabitants. Through these conversations, he gains deep insight into their daily lives, fears, and struggles, which transforms his perspective and leads him to adopt the role of their champion.

**Climax:** A severe, impending storm threatens to destroy the farm and endanger all the animals. Ben must act quickly, orchestrating a complex and daring plan that relies on his new communication skills and the cooperation of the animals to mitigate the disaster.

**Resolution:** The plan succeeds, resulting in the salvation of the farm and the safety of its inhabitants. This victory cements Ben’s role as a protector, granting him a newfound sense of purpose and belonging within the community he has helped save.
